known_information: Issue: ### Microsoft PowerToys version 0.87.1 ### Installation method PowerToys auto-update ### Running as admin No ### Area(s) with issue? Workspaces ### Steps to reproduce 1. Save a workspaces layout with explorer 2. Edit CLI options to add `%windir%` or any other environment variable. 3. Launch workspace. ### ✔️ Expected Behavior It is expected to open explorer to the folder the environment variable leads to. ### ❌ Actual Behavior Explorer opens to default folder. If the environment variable is replaced with the full path `C:\windows` it does open to the correct path. Using power shell style `$env:windir` also does not work. ### Other Software Windows 10 Pro 22H2
